Guide: Tab bar label of the third tab: the bin guide (one page per bin). Short noun.
In %d days: Small uppercase eyebrow on Today before the date, when the next collection is two or more days away: 'In 3 days · Friday 13 November'. %d is always 2 or more.
Out tonight: 44 pt verdict on Today the day before a collection: the bins go out tonight.
Collection today: 44 pt verdict on Today on the collection day.
Nothing tonight: 44 pt verdict on Today when no collection is due tomorrow: nothing to put out tonight.
Done for tonight: 44 pt verdict on Today after the household has rolled the bins to the kerb.
Sentence under the verdict the day before: %@ is the bin list, e.g. 'Recycling, rubbish and food scraps'.
Sentence on the morning of collection day: %@ is the bin list.
Sentence on the afternoon of collection day: %@ is the bin list.
Sentence when the collection is days away: first %@ is the bin list, second is the weekday name, e.g. 'Next: Rubbish on Friday.'
They are at the kerb. Reminders for this: Sentence after the bins were marked as out at the kerb; the app has cancelled this collection's reminders.
Muted line under the bins about the collection after the next: first %@ a full date such as 'Tuesday 17 November', second the bin list.
%@ bins: VoiceOver label of the bin picture: %@ is the bin list, e.g. 'Recycling, rubbish and food scraps bins'.
Swipe right when they are out: VoiceOver hint on the bin picture: swiping right marks the bins as out at the kerb.
Mark bins as out: VoiceOver custom action name: records that the bins are out at the kerb.
Bring the bins back: VoiceOver custom action name and hint on Undo: reverses marking the bins as out.
Undo: Glass button after marking the bins as out; brings them back and restores the reminders.
Turn on reminders: Prominent button on Today when app reminders are switched off; opens Settings.
Allow notifications: Prominent button on Today when iOS notification permission is denied; opens the system settings.
Refresh reminders: Prominent button on Today when the scheduled reminder batch has run out; reschedules.
Reminders paused until %@: Quiet status line on Today while reminders are paused: %@ is a date such as '16 November'.
Reminders on · %@: Quiet status line on Today when reminders are scheduled: %@ lists the reminder times, e.g. '7 pm and 7 am'.
Opens Settings: VoiceOver hint on the quiet status line: tapping it opens Settings.
